text.p: These are the leading stories in the Skopje press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified them nor does it vouch for their accuracy.
- Health minister Ilija Filipce resigned on Tuesday saying he was mo longer in a position to continue the reforms of the health system in the republic.
- Macedonian Prime Minister Branko Crvenkovski announced reconstruction of the governemnt after Easter holidays. The reason was not only in resignations of ministers for construction and health.

- The Macedonian government will discuss ways to compensate savers in bankrupt TAT financial institution at its extraordinary session on Wednesday. TAT's outstanding liability is 113 million German marks and assets only 33 million.

- Borko Stanoevski, Macedonian central bank Governor, suggested bankruptcy of the TAT financial institution as possible means for compensating depositors. -- Mircela Casule, Skopje newsroom 389 91 201 196
